subject: Intro + next steps: economic buyer & procurement process - Orion Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evan Turner <evan.turner@orionsys.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + next steps: economic buyer & procurement process - Orion Systems

Evan —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared starting point and clear next steps: 

- Current use case: scaling an internal assistant for developer docs + ticket summarization (latency sensitive, multi-tenant).
- Key constraints: data residency for some projects, SOC2/compliance questions, predictable monthly spend for pilot.
- Technical champion: Ravi Menon (VP Eng). End-user champion: Maggie Li (Head of Data Science).

Two asks to keep momentum:
1) Could you confirm the economic buyer / budget owner we should align with for a pilot? (Name, role, best email)
2) Any procurement/security contacts we should include early (procurement team, legal)?

Proposed next step: 30-min ROI & pricing review with the budget owner + procurement + our pricing lead. We can also include a short security checklist review with our security lead if procurement wants it on the invite.

I've attached a short pricing summary to help with internal alignment (redwood_pricing_summary.pdf - stub). If you prefer, I can share a ballpark during the call and follow up with a detailed pilot TCO.

Available slots: Tue 6/15 9–11am PT, Wed 6/16 9–12pm PT. What works best?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
redwood.ai

Marissa —

Great notes, thanks. Quick answers / stakeholder map: 

- Economic buyer / budget owner: Jordan Hayes, CFO (j.hayes@orionsys.com) — overall sign-off for pilots > $25k.
- Procurement lead: procurement@orionsys.com (we'll loop in Maria Alvarez from procurement for contract review).
- Technical champion: Ravi Menon (VP Eng) — will own integration & POC.
- End-user champion: Maggie Li (Head DS) — will validate accuracy and metrics.

Procurement will want a short vendor questionnaire and our standard contract term highlights. Maggie also asked whether Redwood can share SOC2 and data handling notes ahead of the call.

We can do Wed 6/16 10:00am PT — Jordan is available then. Please include pricing and security on the invite. I've attached the procurement questionnaire we typically use (filled with a couple of answers I could confirm).

Thanks — I sent invites to Ravi and Maggie; I'll add Jordan and Maria once we confirm.

—Evan

Perfect — thanks for mapping that, Evan. Wed 6/16 10:00am PT works for us; I've penciled it in on our side.

I'll invite: Jordan (CFO), Maria (procurement), Ravi, Maggie, and our internal team: Rishi (pricing/Commercial), Vivek (security/compliance). 

Quick asks so the meeting is high impact: 
- Can you confirm any must-have procurement terms (e.g., PO process, indemnity caps) so Rishi can prep a draft?
- Does procurement require an NDA before sharing any additional documents?
- If possible, could Jordan or Maria share the budget cadence (annual vs. quarterly) so we can align our pilot pricing suggestion?

I'll send a calendar invite for 6/16 10:00am PT and include a short agenda: 1) 10-min pilot scope & success metrics, 2) 10-min pricing & commercial options, 3) 10-min procurement/security Qs.

Link to the HubSpot deal for your reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Marissa

Adding a quick pricing note ahead of Wed so Jordan has context: 

- Pilot (6–8 weeks, up to 50k tokens/day): approximate committed pilot credit $8k–$12k/mo depending on batching/latency SLAs.
- Typical enterprise starter seat (SaaS) or committed throughput pricing: $Xk/month for reserved capacity + usage overage. (Will provide firm numbers in the meeting once we align on retention and KV caching needs.)
- Standard asks: PO + 30-day net, standard vendor contract; for larger commitments we can discuss SOW + SLA.

If procurement has a preferred template, please share — Rishi will prep a redline quickly.

-Rishi
Director, Commercials | Redwood Inference

Note: brief internal pricing figures here are ballpark. Final quote will follow post-scope confirmation.
